prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for all tested kinds of changes (finish/new_screen, sign_in/incentive, home/wait_info, choose_path/copy) as each has only one test so far.
No kinds of change have been proven helpful yet, as no test produced a significant win.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to noise-corrected measurements.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, copy: +0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: -0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, incentive: -3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Sync Flow: Move sign-in to take place after pet pick and adoption certificate creation so users fall in love with their pet before creating an account. (why: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users early. Deferring account creation until after pet customization builds emotional investment first.)
1: [finish, redesign] Interactive Pet Controls Playground: Redesign home_intro into an interactive stage layout where users test dragging, hiding, and talking to their desktop pet directly. (why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets, and finish conversion drops to 64.8%.)
2: [home, new_flow] Background Pet Loader Flow: Transform the waiting step into a split background loader screen showing active desktop permission checks and pet spawning progress. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, and support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on desktop or app stalling.)
3: [choose_path, hint] Quick Start Path Selection Hint: Add a helper badge and path duration hint on choose_path to steer undecided users toward preset adoption. (why: Choose_path has high mean duration (514s) and 23.8% drop-off due to initial path decision friction.)
4: [adoption, layout] Split Pet Selection Stage: Change pick_friend screen layout to split view and add audio previews of pet sounds and voice. (why: Adoption has low conversion (60.9%) and long decision time (median 89s / mean 1017s).)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Permissions Alert Indicator: Enable ready notifications and add a desktop visibility troubleshooting action button during waiting. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet failing to show on desktop, contributing to long wait times (mean 2336s).)
6: [finish, hint] Desktop Command Cheat Sheet Summary: Include shortcut hint copy and step counter display on home_intro to reinforce main controls before exiting onboarding. (why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% and support receives repeated questions about desktop controls.)
7: [choose_path, redesign] Story Mode Onboarding Hub Redesign: Redesign story screen into a interactive video carousel to showcase pet interactions before selecting a path. (why: Improve initial engagement at choose_path where mean duration is 514s and 23.8% drop off before starting.)
